scope: FP-PPOTHER-SLOTRES-CUT: break the FP scalar pp_other -> slot_result_r combinational cone reported by T-037 by adding a second-stage fp_other_mid_t register in scalar_unit for MIN/MAX, FRINT, and FP->int; keep raw-bit/FPCR/FPSR/order semantics and update fixed latency assertions.

implementation.summary: In release FP_ITER=1 g_iter, added IT_OTHER pipeline stage and fp_other_mid_t ot_mid/ot_mid_lo/ot_mid_hi registers. Stage 1 (IT_IDLE) still captures unpacked/FZ-flushed operands to pp_other*; stage 2 (IT_OTHER) performs the expensive compare/shift/magnitude/saturate work for FMIN/FMAX/FMINNM/FMAXNM, FRINT, FCVTZS/FCVTZU and writes ot_mid*; stage 3 (IT_PREP) does only final select/normalize/pack/int result. This splits the T-037 pp_other.pa.exp2 -> slot_result_r path (51 levels / 26.489 ns / -6.207 ns). FCMP remains on the original two-stage pp_other path.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; same unpack/FZ/round/saturate rules, only split into decision+final stages
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at acceptance, FPSR OR behavior preserved
semantics.fcmp_nzcv: unchanged; CMP still uses pp_other two-stage finish
semantics.fp_to_gpr: unchanged; FCVTZS/FCVTZU int_result pipeline still driven through staged ot_mid
semantics.kill_reset: ot_mid* registers cleared on reset/kill with other pipeline registers

runs.notes: Verilator lint-only on lcvex_core with release filelist

runs.command: conda run -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -j 1 --top-module lcvex_fp_exec_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_fp_scalar.sv rtl/lcvex_neon_fp.sv tb/sv/lcvex_fp_exec_tb.sv && ./obj_dir/Vlcvex_fp_exec_tb
runs.notes: Updated FMIN.S=5, FMAX.S=5, FCVTZS.S=5, NEON FRINTZ.2S=9; includes single issue, held response, kill/reset, FDIV/FSQRT latency probes
First run caught a staged-minmax FMAX selection bug (returned min); fixed by encoding FMIN/FMAX selection choice in mm_use_a. Rerun after fix is all green.

not_run: Quartus full-FP synthesis/fitter/signoff STA (next FP-P5 rerun required)
A76 required L2 lockstep sub-suite (not affected by this FP unit cut)
known_limits: No physical timing run in this task; actual Fmax/slack must be confirmed by FP-P5 rerun.
FP p_other non-CMP scalar operations and corresponding NEON slots gained one pipeline cycle.
If STA still shows pp_other -> ot_mid or ot_mid -> slot_result as top, a further split (e.g. FRINT shift vs normalize, minmax 256-bit compare) may be needed.
FCMP remains on the original two-stage pp_other path; if it becomes a new top a dedicated minmax-style cut may be needed.

integrator_review.notes: FP pp_other->slot_result cut merged and accepted
